warning: Sanitized historical example. Not installation authority or current inventory.

target.legacyRemovalMode: Move only the exact attested legacy app to the owner's Trash

absence.rollback: A new reviewed enabled-state commit restores only the exact retired app, daemon, marker and Dock tile; profiles and keys are not recoverable from this stage

lifecycle.install: Verify the signed package and checksum, expand without scripts, preserve the app signature, install a loopback-only root daemon, remove the exact legacy app from Applications recoverably, and pin the desktop app in the Dock
lifecycle.smoke: Verify application identity, strict signature, Gatekeeper, Rosetta, service identity, loopback listener, Dock tile, legacy-app absence, widget-extension absence, fallback VPN, DNS, and HTTPS
lifecycle.connectionTest: Requires a user-provided connection configuration and is intentionally outside the installation gate
lifecycle.rollback: Flip the legacy-retention and Dock flags in an exact commit to restore the attested legacy app from Trash and remove only the managed Dock tile
lifecycle.remove: Use the distinct absent state. Retire only exact managed payloads, remove the exact Dock tile and empty system support directories, and leave profile/key purge to the separately bounded owner operation. Never call the vendor uninstaller
